name: Originx 北极星指标（服务层级）
description: 从 Grafana 面板迁移并汉化，已转换为“我的面板”原生格式。来源：originx-polaris-service。

variables.name: cluster_id
variables.label: 集群
variables.query:
SELECT DISTINCT scope_id AS __value, 
CASE 
  WHEN c.name != '' THEN c.name
  ELSE scope_id
END AS __text
FROM data_scope 
LEFT JOIN clusters c ON scope_id  = c.id
WHERE type = 'cluster'

widgets.title: 请求次数
widgets.description: 请求次数。

query.expression: sum by (content_key, svc_name) (increase(kindling_span_trace_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name=~"${service_name:regex}", content_key=~"${content_key:regex}", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$interval]))

query.expression: sum by (svc_name, content_key) (increase(kindling_span_trace_duration_nanoseconds_count{is_error="false", svc_name=~"${service_name:regex}", content_key=~"${content_key:regex}", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$interval]))/sum by (svc_name, content_key) (increase(kindling_span_trace_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name=~"${service_name:regex}", content_key=~"${content_key:regex}", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$interval])) OR on() vector(0)
